parsed.rationale: Legal team is reviewing a DPA and requesting confirmation on subprocessors, data retention, and whether support logs can include customer identifiers; this is privacy/legal compliance handling.

parsed.draft_response:
Subject: Re: DPA clarification for EU customer data

Hi there,

Thanks for flagging this. I understand your legal team is reviewing our DPA and needs confirmation on (1) subprocessors, (2) data retention, and (3) whether support logs can include customer identifiers.

I’m going to route this to our privacy/compliance contact for a human review. To ensure they address the exact points needed for your review, could you please share:
1) Which specific DPA document/version is being reviewed (or the link/version name)
2) The names of the subprocessors you’re asking about (or whether you mean the full subprocessor list)
3) The exact data retention question (e.g., the retention period(s) you want confirmed, and for which data types)
4) Which “support logs” you mean (which systems/components), and the specific question about including customer identifiers (e.g., whether identifiers are permitted, required, or always redacted)

Once we have those details, our privacy/compliance team can provide the appropriate confirmations for your legal review.

Best regards, 
[Your Name]
Support / Compliance Liaison
promised_actions: Route the request to the privacy/compliance contact for human review
safety_notes: Acknowledges escalation for human review without claiming resolution.
Does not promise a refund, fix, SLA, or legal conclusion.
Requests minimum clarifications needed because key details (DPA version, exact subprocessors/retention/log scope) are not provided.

parsed.customer_impact: Compliance/legal approval may be required before EU customer records can be enabled, potentially delaying onboarding or activation for EU customers until DPA clarification is provided.
